Are you passionate about driving growth through digital media? Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and commercial impact? Then this could be the role for you.

We are looking for a Digital Media Manager to help shape and develop how Tre works with paid digital media investments with a strong focus on performance marketing and traffic acquisition. This is an exciting opportunity to take on a newly established role with significant influence, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution and a clear impact on business results.

About the roleAs Digital Media Manager, you will be responsible for Tre's paid digital media investments and the development of our performance media strategy. You will plan, prioritize, and optimize investments across the digital landscape together with our media agency focusing on channels such as Google, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and other relevant platforms.

You will work closely with both our Online and Commercial teams and serve as Tre's internal digital media expert. The role also involves close collaboration with external media agency, where you will act as a key point of contact.

To succeed in this role, you need to be both strategic and analytical. You are curious about what drives performance, comfortable challenging existing ways of working, and skilled at turning insights into recommendations that create tangible business value.

What you'll do

Own and develop Tre's digital media strategy, with a focus on traffic acquisition, media investments, and digital performance.
Plan, prioritize and evaluate digital campaigns while managing budgets, forecasting, and performance reporting.
Translate data and insights into actionable recommendations and drive strategic discussions with media agencies and internal stakeholders.
Collaborate across functions to identify new opportunities within digital marketing, AI, and automation.
Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert within digital media and performance marketing.

How hiring manager, Maria, describes her leadership style:  "I believe in a leadership style built on openness, transparency, and accessibility. We encourage dialogue, initiative, and the courage to try new things, while collaboration remains a key factor in our success. You'll join a fast-paced environment where people support one another, share knowledge, and work together towards common goals."

We believe you will bring the following:

Minimum 5 years of experience in digital media and performance marketing.
A strong understanding of the digital media landscape and how different channels, strategies, and buying models work together to drive business results.
Hands-on experience within platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, and other relevant advertising platforms.
Experience with analytics and marketing measurement, including attribution, digital analytics, or marketing mix modelling.
Knowledge of tracking, measurement, and data quality, with an interest in developing data-driven ways of working.
Experience managing large budgets and optimizing investments against business objectives.
The ability to transform complex data into clear insights, recommendations, and business value.
Experience leading projects and collaborating with multiple stakeholders across different functions.
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
Experience working with traditional media and media agencies is highly valued, though not required.
Experience within the telecommunications industry is considered an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

Who you are

You are analytical, commercially minded, and naturally curious. You enjoy diving into data and uncovering insights, while also being able to step back and see the bigger business picture. With a strong understanding of creative and effective communication, you know how to translate insights into actions that drive impact and business results.As this is a new role within Tre, you are comfortable creating structure where not everything is fully defined. You enjoy taking initiative, driving change, and bringing people along on the journey. At the same time, you are collaborative, humble, and focused on finding the best solutions together with others. You build strong relationships and establish trust with a variety of stakeholders, whether they are specialists, leaders, or external partners.We look forward to receiving your application!

Please apply through this job advertisement. We review applications on an ongoing basis. You do not need to submit a cover letter – simply attach your CV and answer the questions included in the application.

Here’s what the recruitment process looks like:

We start by reviewing applications, followed by assessments and a brief phone interview. You will then meet the hiring manager for an initial interview, followed by a competency-based interview with our Talent Acquisition Partner. For the final candidate, the process also includes reference checks and a background check.

Your role
Atlas Copco Group operates in a rapidly changing environment shaped by technological disruption, geopolitical uncertainty, shifting competitive dynamics and increasingly interconnected markets. Management needs more than summaries of external events. It needs a clear understanding of what is changing, why it matters, which business assumptions may be challenged and what should be monitored or explored further.
As Strategic Risk Intelligence Specialist, you will strengthen the forward-looking capabilities of Group Risk Management. You will combine strategic intelligence, scenario planning, analytics and AI-enabled research to support discussions across Business Areas, Divisions and Group Functions. This is not a traditional compliance, insurance or risk-administration role. It is a business-oriented analytical position focused on uncertainty and decision support.
Your mission is to convert complex and sometimes conflicting information into clear, evidence-based insight. You will help identify emerging developments, develop plausible scenarios, monitor critical assumptions and create concise material for management discussions. You will own the intelligence process and analytical preparation, working closely with the Vice President Group Risk Management & Insurance and colleagues across the Group.
Your day-to-day
Strategic intelligence and horizon scanning
Monitor and analyze macro trends, external developments and emerging signals relevant to the Group’s businesses, markets and operating environment. This includes industrial technology, AI, competition, geopolitics, trade, macroeconomics, sustainability, supply chains, customers and business-model change.
Produce concise intelligence reports, emerging-issue assessments and management briefings.
Maintain a structured, traceable repository of trends, signals and supporting evidence.

Scenario planning and strategic foresight
Develop plausible, differentiated and business-relevant scenarios.
Develop and monitor signposts covering material uncertainties.
Maintain a practical Group scenario library and support strategic stress testing and resilience assessments.
Recommend topics requiring deeper analysis, escalation or management attention.

Strategic risk analysis and decision support
Connect external intelligence with ERM, insurance and claims, loss prevention, supply-chain, resilience, financial and business information.
Develop dashboards and visualizations that clarify implications and choices.

AI-enabled risk intelligence
Use AI-enabled tools to improve horizon scanning, synthesis, scenario development and indicator monitoring.
Define business problems, expected value, information requirements and success criteria for potential AI use cases.
Work with the AI Expert, IT and data teams to develop appropriate solutions.

ERM and management reporting support
Prepare analyses, scenarios and assumption maps for objective-centric ERM workshops.
Add a forward-looking perspective to Group risk reporting and track management-attention topics over time.

Collaboration and capability development
Collaborate with Business Areas, Divisions, Group Functions and internal subject-matter experts to understand context and validate conclusions.
Work closely with colleagues in ERM, resilience, insurance, loss prevention, finance, strategy, IT, information security, legal and sustainability.
Build an effective network of external intelligence sources and internal expertise.
Share methods, tools and good practices for scenario analysis, assumption monitoring and AI-enabled 

Your skills and experience
What you bring
A master’s degree or equivalent qualification in engineering, economics, business administration, strategy, analytics, political science, international relations, technology or innovation management, or another relevant analytical field. Equivalent professional experience may also be considered
Approximately five to eight years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, strategic planning, business or market intelligence, strategic foresight, business development, risk analytics, enterprise risk management or data-driven business analysis.
Strong ability to structure ambiguous questions, synthesize large amounts of information and translate analysis into business implications.
Experience with scenario planning, strategic analysis, management reporting or comparable forward-looking analytical work.
Hands-on experience using generative AI and analytical tools, combined with a critical approach to output quality and source validation. Programming or scripting experience (e.g. Python, SQL) and familiarity with APIs and integrations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions, cultures and organizational levels.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

It is an advantage if you have
Experience from a global industrial, engineering or technology-driven organization.
Experience translating geopolitical, technological or competitive developments into business implications.
Experience with Power BI or comparable visualization tools, advanced Excel and executive presentation development.
Familiarity with ERM or GRC platforms and enterprise data environments.

Who you are
You are intellectually curious and motivated by understanding how the operating environment is changing. You enjoy connecting developments across technology, markets, competition, geopolitics and business strategy. You are comfortable with ambiguity but disciplined about evidence. You can develop a hypothesis without becoming attached to it and revise your view when the evidence changes.
You combine strategic thinking with practical execution. You do not stop at describing a trend. You ask why it matters, which assumptions may be affected, what evidence supports the conclusion, what would indicate that conditions are changing and how the insight could influence a management decision.
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a Lead Engineer - Plants who wants to take on a key role at HVDC in technical leadership in tenders and projects. You will have the responsibility to coordinate global teams with focus on Plants and Civil engineering design solutions and its interfaces for our onshore and offshore converter stations.  
As a Lead Engineer - Plants, you will drive strategic technical decision making, ensure that our design solutions meet customer requirements, quality standards and project goals. You interact with other stakeholders such as customers, contractors, supply chain and site team, contributing to the successful delivery of some of the world's most advanced energy infrastructure projects. The role is offering a unique opportunity to contribute to the global energy transition while working in a highly collaborative and international environment. This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden.

"Are you ready to become part of a group of technical leaders with a passion for supporting our engineering teams and driving them forward? We work closely with many different functions and as a Lead Engineer - Plants, you will play a key role in driving transparency around technical solutions and their impact on projects that contribute to a greener future."
– Kamilla Sommarsjö, Global Head HVDC Lead Engineers - Plants
How You'll Make an Impact
Provide strong technical leadership across Plants and Civil engineering teams and their interfaces.
Primary contact for technical communication with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
Drive completion of engineering activities in tenders and projects, working closely with technical leads, project managers, and interface managers.
Manage technical risks and ensure compliance with quality, safety and engineering processes.
Support installation and commissioning activities by providing expert technical guidance.
Lead development of new technical solutions while interpreting customer’s needs and expectations.
Take a strategic role in defining Plants and Civil solutions for onshore HVDC converter stations and offshore platforms.
Coordinate engineering activities across key disciplines, including:
Electromechanical Design
Station Auxiliary Power Systems
Civil Engineering
Auxiliary Systems (eg Fire Protection, HVAC, Security Systems)
Ensure effective coordination and management of interfaces between engineering disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.
Represent the Plants discipline in customer meetings, partner discussions, and technical reviews.

Your Background
Academic degree in Engineering (for example within Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related area)
At least 5 years of engineering experience, including experience of leading technical teams, multidisciplinary engineering activities or complex projects is required.
Experience within HVDC, transmission systems, substations, electrical power systems, offshore wind, or other large-scale energy infrastructure projects is highly valued.
Strong technical understanding with the ability to quickly develop expertise in HVDC technology and systems.
A collaborative and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders across functions and geographic locations.
Strong leadership skills and the confidence to make technical decisions when required.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to present technical solutions in a clear and structured manner.
Fluency in English, both verbally and written, is required. Other languages are an advantage.

As a person, you are passionate about both people and technology. You thrive in a dynamic environment, take ownership of your responsibilities, and are motivated by solving complex technical challenges together with others.
More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​

Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​

Are you passionate about protein analytics and scientific problem-solving? Would you like to contribute to the development of innovative injectable products in a global, science-driven organization? We are looking for a Scientist to join our Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry team within Injectables Development in Uppsala.
In this role, you will contribute to the development and validation of analytical methods that support the advancement of new products and technologies. Working in a collaborative and highly skilled environment, you will help generate the scientific insights that drive innovation and ensure product quality throughout development.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing organization where your expertise will contribute directly to the future of injectable aesthetics.
Make your mark. Grow with us. 
 
Your team 
Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry is part of Galderma's Injectables Development organization in Uppsala. The team provides analytical expertise that supports the development of innovative products and technologies, helping to strengthen and expand Galderma's portfolio.
You will join a collaborative and highly engaged team where knowledge sharing, scientific curiosity, and mutual support are valued. Together, we work in a dynamic environment where quality, innovation, and patient focus guide everything we do.
 
Your mission
As a Scientist within Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry, you will plan, perform, and interpret analytical studies supporting product and process development. You will contribute to solving complex analytical challenges related to proteins and biologics while ensuring that all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable quality standards and regulatory requirements.
Working closely with colleagues across Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions, you will play an important role in advancing development projects from early-stage investigations through method validation and implementation.
This role offers a broad range of scientific and technical challenges, providing opportunities to deepen your expertise while contributing to projects with real impact on Galderma's future portfolio.
 
Key responsibilities
· Develop, optimize, and validate analytical methods for proteins and related biological materials.
· Plan, execute, analyze, and document experimental work.
· Interpret analytical data and provide scientifically sound conclusions and recommendations.
· Author protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.
· Provide analytical expertise and support within cross-functional development projects.
· Ensure that all activities are performed in accordance with GMP, internal procedures, and relevant regulatory requirements.
· Support project teams by identifying scientific solutions to analytical challenges.
· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory and analytical development processes.
 
Your profile 
You are a curious and collaborative scientist who enjoys combining scientific expertise with practical problem-solving. You are motivated by understanding complex biological systems and translating analytical results into meaningful insights that support product development.
You thrive in an environment where teamwork, scientific discussion, and continuous learning are valued. At the same time, you take ownership of your work, approach challenges with a structured mindset, and maintain a strong focus on quality and scientific integrity.
You are comfortable working in project-based environments, communicating complex information clearly, and collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds.
 
What you'll bring
To be successful in this role, you bring:
· A university degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biology, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
· Experience working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or broader life sciences industry.
· Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry, biochemistry, protein characterization, or related scientific fields.
· Experience with analytical method development and validation.
· Experience working in regulated environments and familiarity with GMP and associated quality requirements.
· Experience interpreting regulatory guidelines, pharmacopeias, and scientific standards.
· Fluency in both English and Swedish, written and spoken.
 
Preferred qualifications 
Experience in any of the following areas would be considered an advantage:
Immunology and anti-drug antibody (ADA) testing.
Protein therapeutics, biologics, or biosimilar development.
Advanced protein characterization techniques.
Analytical support in cross-functional development projects.
Statistical evaluation of analytical data.

 
Location and other
This position is based on site in Uppsala, Sweden. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

Company Description

Our Tranås site brings together manufacturing, research and development, and business functions, creating an environment where ideas and decisions are closely connected to our products and operations.
We believe in technology that makes a difference: Invented for life.
 

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Do you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers?
As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing, partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions.
You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance.

Would you like to help develop the next generation of birch forests? Join our research team and investigate how flowering and seed production can support faster progress in forest tree breeding.
Improved planting material contributes to productive and resilient forests. In silver birch, efficient breeding and reliable seed production depend on our ability to understand and influence flowering. Skogforsk is seeking a motivated PhD student to investigate these processes and develop methods that can be applied in breeding programmes and seed production.
The position is part of Phase II of Trees For Me, a centre of excellence focusing on fast-growing broadleaved trees for sustainable forests, materials and energy.

Research project and duties
The overall aim of this four-year PhD project is to improve our understanding of flowering in silver birch and develop practical methods to promote early and reliable flowering and seed production.
The project will investigate how environmental conditions and cultivation treatments influence flowering in young plants and older breeding material. Particular attention will be given to light conditions, plant development and genetic differences in flowering responses. The research will connect fundamental questions about reproductive development with practical challenges in birch breeding.
Earlier flowering could shorten the breeding cycle and help realise the benefits of genomic selection by allowing selected individuals to be crossed at a younger age. Improved control of flowering could also support more reliable seed production.
Your work will include:
Planning, establishing and managing experiments in controlled environments, greenhouses and, where relevant, the field.
Assessing growth, development, male and female flowering, and seed production and quality.
Analysing experimental data using statistical methods.
Publishing scientific papers and communicating results to researchers, breeders and other stakeholders.
Completing doctoral courses in forest genetics, breeding and related subjects.

The detailed research questions and experimental programme will be developed together with the supervisory team.

Trees For Me – Phase II
Trees For Me brings together universities, research institutes, industry and public-sector organisations to develop knowledge and solutions for the sustainable use of fast-growing broadleaved trees, including birch, poplar and aspen.
Within Phase II, this PhD project will contribute knowledge and methods to strengthen birch breeding and the supply of improved reproductive material. The student will participate in an interdisciplinary research environment and collaborate with researchers and stakeholders across the forest sector.

Research environment
The project is a collaboration between Skogforsk and the Southern Swedish Forest Research Centre at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Alnarp. The student will be employed by Skogforsk and based at the Ekebo research station in Svalöv, with doctoral enrolment at SLU.
You will join a team working with forest tree genetics, breeding and seed production. The position offers close contact with operational breeding, access to experimental facilities and breeding material, and opportunities for national and international collaboration.

Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated and curious candidate with a master’s degree in forestry, biology, plant science, genetics, environmental science or an equivalent subject relevant to the project.
You should have an interest in experimental research, plant development and the practical application of scientific results. Good communication skills and proficiency in spoken and written English are essential.
The following qualifications are considered merits:
Knowledge of plant physiology, flowering biology, forest genetics or tree breeding.
Experience in establishing and managing plant experiments.
Experience in statistical analysis and programming in R or equivalent software.
Experience working with plants in greenhouses, controlled environments or field trials.

You should be able to work independently and collaboratively, organise your work carefully and take responsibility for practical experiments. A valid driving licence is required.
Applicants must meet SLU’s requirements for admission to doctoral studies.

Employment and application
Employment: Four-year, fixed-term employment as a PhD student at Skogforsk.
Location: Ekebo research station, Svalöv, Sweden.
Starting date: By agreement.
Application deadline: 6 December.
Your application should include:
A cover letter describing your motivation, relevant experience and research interests.
A CV.Degree certificates and transcripts.
Contact details for two referees.

Send your application to eva.persson@skogforsk.se, using the subject line “PhD application – birch”. Deadline for application is 6th of December.
For further information, please contact Mateusz Liziniewicz (mateusz.liziniewicz@skogforsk.se), Researcher, Skogforsk.

About Skogforsk
Skogforsk is the Swedish forestry research institute. Our vision is "World-class forestry for sustainable development." We develop and communicate knowledge, services, and products that contribute to the sustainable development of forestry for the benefit of society.
We operate at three locations: Uppsala, Sävar in Västerbotten, and Ekebo in Skåne. In total, we have approximately 160 employees.
At Ekebo, our research includes forest tree breeding, genetics and the production of improved planting material.

jobs.occupation: Design Engineer  Power Supply Units & Electrical Components
jobs.description:
We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups - and we’re just getting started. 
At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future -  and we want you to be part of it. 

About the Team
The Electromechanics Design Department within Global Robotics R&D Technology consists of 16 engineers specializing in verification, mechanics, mechatronics, and electronics. We are responsible for the electromechanical systems used in our robotic mower platforms and work across the complete product lifecycle, from technology investigations and feasibility studies to product development projects and maintenance activities.
Our team defines system requirements, drives technical coordination across disciplines, and leads verification and validation activities in close collaboration with software, electronics, sourcing, quality, and manufacturing teams.
We offer an international and collaborative working environment characterized by openness, professionalism, and a strong passion for technology and innovation.

About the role
We are looking for a Design Engineer with experience in electrical and/or electromechanical component development to strengthen our electromechanics team.
In this role, you will play a key part in the development of future robotic platforms and act as a technical contributor and coordinator in cross-functional projects. Depending on experience, the role may also include technical leadership responsibilities.
The primary focus of the role is the development and management of Power Supply Units (PSUs), including PSUs both with and without communication interfaces. Responsibility also includes other electrical components such as wiring harnesses, user interface hardware, connectors, and related electromechanical subsystems.
Development activities are carried out in close collaboration with both internal stakeholders and external development partners and suppliers.

Your responsibilities will include:
Development, specification, and integration of power supply units and other electrical components
Defining component requirements and securing technical compliance throughout the product lifecycle
Coordinating development activities in tight cooperation with suppliers and external engineering partners
Leading technical investigations, concept evaluations, and feasibility studies
Cross-functional coordination in tight cooperation with mechanics, electronics, sourcing, quality, manufacturing, and others
Planning and execution of verification and validation activities
Driving continuous improvements in development methodologies, processes, and engineering tools
Supporting technology roadmaps and future platform strategies within electrical systems and components

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent
About 3 years of relevant industrial experience
Experience in product development involving electrical or electromechanical systems
Experience working with suppliers and external development partners
Strong communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

Meritorious Experience
The following experience is considered highly valuable:
Development and specification of Power Supply Units (PSUs)
Electrical distribution systems, wiring harnesses, connectors, and related components
Low-voltage electrical systems and electronics integration
Product development within consumer products, robotics, automotive, or related industries
Verification and validation of electrical and electromechanical products, especially round component certification
Technical leadership or project coordination
Experience working with global suppliers and development partners
Experience with CATIA Electrical or other similar 3D tools
Experience with Teamcenter and product lifecycle management (PLM) systems

Personal Profile
We are looking for a curious and driven engineer with a genuine interest in technology and product development. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges. You enjoy collaborating across disciplines, building strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, and contributing to the development of both products and working methods.
You have a pragmatic mindset, can balance technical details with a system perspective, and are motivated by turning concepts into robust production-ready solutions.

Location
The assignment is based at Husqvarna Group's Robotics R&D center in Huskvarna, Sweden. A significant on-site presence is expected, as close collaboration with development teams, suppliers, prototypes, products, and test equipment is an essential part of the role.

Your application: 
Apply as soon as possible. We are screening on an ongoing basis and will fill this position as soon as we have found the right person. For more information about the position, contact hiring manager Staffan Palm on staffan.palm@husqvarnagroup.com For questions regarding the process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Kristin Sundlo on Kristin.sundlo@husqvarnagroup.com

Processing of personal data 
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. 
For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and your rights, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Job Description
Are you passionate about the evolving creator economy and how creators can drive both brand relevance and commercial impact? We’re looking for a Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce to shape and build how we work with creator-led commerce at scale. 
In this role, you’ll lead the strategic direction of our creator affiliate offering and turn that strategy into scalable capabilities, ways of working and measurable business results. You’ll connect creator marketing, affiliate and commercial opportunities, ensuring our approach supports both short-term performance and long-term creator relationships. 
You’ll work closely with Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams to build a connected creator ecosystem and unlock the full potential of our creator partnerships across the business. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 
As Creator Marketing Lead - Affiliate & Creator Commerce, you’ll shape the strategy and build the capabilities required to grow creator commerce across markets. You’ll translate strategic priorities into clear plans, processes, tools and technology, while driving collaboration across teams and markets. 
You will: 
Define and drive the creator affiliate and commerce strategy, ensuring it complements the broader affiliate strategy and overall creator marketing direction. 
Build scalable operating models, processes, tools and technology that enable creator commerce across markets. 
Shape quarterly strategies, priorities and budget allocation within your area. 
Work closely with markets to identify commercial opportunities and define activation plans. 
Lead and guide Creator Marketing Specialists and Coordinators in campaign execution and delivery. 
Oversee campaign execution, budget management, performance and stakeholder alignment. 
Identify opportunities to maximise creator value across awareness, engagement and conversion. 
Build strong collaboration across Creator Marketing, Affiliate, Media and local market teams, ensuring partnerships and creator relationships are leveraged strategically across initiatives. 
Balance performance and commercial objectives with long-term creator relationships and strong brand alignment. 
Use performance insights and learnings to continuously evolve the creator commerce offering and identify new opportunities for growth. 

WHO YOU ARE 
We’re looking for a strategic and commercially minded creator marketing professional who combines deep expertise with a builder mentality. You’re comfortable setting direction, but equally motivated by turning strategy into something tangible, scalable and actionable. 
You understand both the relationship-driven side of creator marketing and the performance-driven nature of affiliate and creator commerce. You can navigate a complex stakeholder landscape, influence across teams and markets and turn business needs into clear operational and technical requirements. 
We are looking for people with: 
Extensive experience within creator, influencer or affiliate marketing, with strong expertise in creator commerce and performance-driven partnerships. 
Proven experience building or scaling creator-led commercial or affiliate programmes. 
Strong strategic planning and prioritisation skills, with the ability to translate strategy into execution. 
A solid understanding of affiliate platforms, tracking, attribution, tools and technology supporting creator commerce. 
A commercial mindset with a strong focus on measurable results, business impact and optimisation. 
Experience managing budgets, priorities and performance across multiple initiatives or markets. 
Excellent stakeholder management skills and confidence working across senior, cross-functional and international teams. 
Experience leading, coaching or guiding specialists and coordinators in campaign delivery. 
The ability to balance short-term commercial opportunities with long-term creator relationships and brand priorities. 
A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with the drive to build new capabilities and ways of working.

 
WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 
 

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter. 
 
 
JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time permanent position based in Stockholm. Please apply as soon as possible by submitting your CV in English. Due to data privacy regulations, we only accept applications through our career page.  
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Join the world class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Health and Safety Manager. As the Health and Safety Manager you will own the Health and Safety function of your respective area. 
You will be responsible for improving the health and safety of our data centers, advancing safety culture, and protecting our employees. Each day you will work with our data center engineers, the people who make the cloud go. They are working with electrical switching equipment, large scale air handling mechanical systems, and critical IT gear. You will work closely with experts in security, construction, operations, logistics, compliance, corporate counsel, and human resources to further the global health safety program. You will partner with employees as well as contractors to achieve health and safety goals and improve our already strong safety culture. As AWS increases data capacity you will partner with construction managers to ensure risks are identified and mitigated prior to live operations. You will work in a fast-paced environment where our operations are rapidly changing, advocating safe changes in the face of new infrastructure, new tools, and new products/processes.
This role is for an experienced Safety Specialist or Safety Engineer. The role's prime responsibility will be to support the safety operations for Data Centers. You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives. You must be an effective communicator, sending clear, concise and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and/or public speaking forums. You will advise, instruct and train company personnel on safety policies and procedures, as well as assist the teams in incorporating and improving our safety standards at their sites. You will report to the Regional Safety Manager – EMEA and be responsible for continuing to enhance the safety of operations and construction. Some domestic and international travel is required. 
Key job responsibilities
Implement safety standards, policies and best practices.
Provision and Management of Training: Induction, Refresher Training as required, develop and deliver training/presentations to support achievement of H&S objectives. Ensure all H&S training requirements are fulfilled.
Collaborate with vendors (General Contractors, sub-contractors, Emergency Services) as they relate to operations and construction.
Ensure compliance and implementation of global safety programs and local regulatory legislation. 
Develop and review safety plans for on-site emergencies, special events and other unique safety situations.
Perform safety data analysis and create bench marking.
Ensure safety record keeping and provide accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
Consult and work with compliance teams on safety regulations interpretations and investigations. 
Develop and implement solutions to eliminate exposure to risks and prevent injury.
Adapt to fast-paced environments with changing circumstances, direction, strategy and deadlines. 
Able to work as part of a team and provide safety support to regions outside of local cluster when required.
Other duties as assigned.

About the team
We’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. 
Basic qualifications
Minimum 5+ years of field experience in in a Health & Safety role within operational environments. 
Fluent English language skill required (written and verbal communication). 
Valid driver's license.
Ability to work on-site at office and Data Center locations.

Preferred qualifications
Considerable knowledge of local safety and health regulatory laws and practices and workplace safety. 
Experience / knowledge of implementing safety programs, processes, and procedural documentation. 
Data center, manufacturing, construction, or similar industry safety experience with mix of full-time employees and third-party contractors.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. jobs.occupation: Radiographer – Daytime position in coastal Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are currently recruiting two radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in coastal central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance, with daytime working hours and no evenings, nights, weekends or public holidays.
The department
The department is a smaller radiology unit with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with new technology, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, providing the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in a setting with a higher acute patient flow.
The role
The position includes standard duties as a radiographer, primarily within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00. There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous experience as a radiographer is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with CT and conventional radiography is considered particularly valuable.
 
 
The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area combines small-town living with close access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to those looking for a quieter lifestyle with good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
The area offers access to schools and childcare, as well as good transport connections to larger cities.
Requirements
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised qualification as a Radiographer
The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
Is interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Enjoys working as part of a team and has as a professional and patient-centred approach
Has good communication skills in English
Is motivated to learn Swedish and adapt to the Swedish healthcare system
Is interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

 
Language and relocation
Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a Radiography Assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1.
Work and language training are combined during this period, with work in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
The language education is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin working fully as a radiographer once the required Swedish language level has been reached and Swedish professional authorization has been obtained.
Salary
During the language completion phase while employed as a Radiography Assistant, the salary is:
30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and beginning work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is:
31,100 SEK/month gross
The salary as an authorised radiographer may be individually determined depending on previous professional experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
Please submit:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates
Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

Interested?
If you are a qualified radiographer interested in building a long-term career and life in Sweden, we would be happy to hear from you.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.
